@codiesanchez left a finance career managing hundreds of millions in assets to buy laundromats, car washes and roofing companies, then built a 15-million-follower movement teaching others to do the same.

Contrarian Thinking now operates across media, investment and advisory, and her new book Own or Be Owned is built around one core idea: know yourself before you follow anyone else's formula.

This is her story. Read the full feature online now (link in bio) and in print starting Sept. 22.

Thank you to Forbes for a seat with an unreal group on the 2026 Top Creators List. I never set out to be a creator, I just wanted to tell people the truth about ownership and money. The content side was just me telling you what I figured out along the way. Floored that it landed me here.

If I have a son I’m gonna teach him the difference between right and wrong, and if I have a daughter, I’m gonna teach her how to say no, shoot guns, and break jaws. Sooooo your son better be taught respect. 

I believe in due process, yet this entire case makes me sad for men and women, teach your sons when a woman is incapacitated to send her home not take advantage. Teach your daughters to protect and love themselves.

I hate this war between the sexes, as there is no stronger protector than my husband, my father, my teams that I work with. But what it reminds me is we need to raise strong value driven women. Because the world won’t be strong for them.
